scope: Simplified Chinese equipment names, selected monster names, equipment option texts and name labels
status: Source review completed; awaiting user Windows build and gameplay acceptance. Not published to an upstream PR.
choices: Names are matched by item group/number and monster number; local OpenMU names are supporting terminology only.
Current English strings, item and monster identifiers, numeric rules, models, maps and other existing languages are preserved.
The source spans a later client version; only corresponding names and compatible terminology are adopted.
Item 5/20 uses 恒翼之杖: the official name 恒翼之仗 is normalized to the staff spelling matching Eternal Wing Stick.
Monster name 死灵巫師 uses the Simplified Chinese character 师; parentheses in training-soldier names use full-width punctuation.
Monster 12 retains 毒虫; monster 532 gets its own 幼虫 name while its inherited English, Spanish and Portuguese names remain unchanged.
Option templates retain the current {value}/{divisor} variables, plus signs and percentages; fixed values from newer resources are not imported.
Zen retains the previously accepted 金币 terminology.
Version-specific and unreviewed entries retain English fallback; Wizard Ring level variants remain outside this batch.

monster_names.choice_note: The official area guide calls this monster 寒冰巨人; the available official Chinese client names number 449 火焰巨人. Adopt the official-client name under the required source order. Both are official-source wording; this is a source/version naming difference.
